decisions.reason: A net price display plugin is a low-maintenance extension that serves B2B shop clients and fits the core offer.
An ERP interface plugin builds on the established offer, creates strong client lock-in, and supports the multichannel strategy.
Price comparison tracking supports the firm's measurable-marketing promise and costs little to maintain.
This tracking plugin likely targets a different comparison portal, so it adds channel coverage at small upkeep, though overlap with C carries some risk of consolidation.
This third tracking variant is cheap to host and broadens portal coverage, but it is the most likely of the three to be merged or discontinued.
Net price reporting complements the net price display plugin for B2B clients and requires minimal resources.
